# ESA WorldCover 2021 v200

- **Source**: European Space Agency (ESA) / VITO Remote Sensing
- **URL**: https://esa-worldcover.org/en / https://services.terrascope.be/wms/v2
- **Citation**: Zanaga, D., et al. (2022). ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200.
- **Licence**: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
- **Resolution**: 10m global land cover raster
- **Use**: Primary land cover class fractions (Cropland, Tree cover, Built-up, Permanent water bodies, Herbaceous wetland, Bare/sparse)
- **Access Route**: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) via HTTP range requests / Terrascope tile endpoint
